verdict.rationale: ScrapingBee's Usage API reports real-time concurrency usage per account, which implies concurrent requests are a metered, supported capability. The official CLI also offers crawl commands for larger collection runs. However, the evidence never states concurrency limits, how far it scales, or how to orchestrate many parallel sessions; session_id is only sticky-IP routing, not concurrency. Missing for 10: documented concurrency limits or plan tiers, guidance on running parallel requests at scale, independent or hands-on corroboration of high-concurrency throughput.

support.subject: As a data-engineer, I can spin up many concurrent scraping sessions to gather data at scale

citations.quote: Read real-time credit and concurrency usage for the authenticated ScrapingBee account.
`scrapingbee crawl` | Quick same-domain crawl, sitemap crawl, or Scrapy-project spider.
